purpose: Define an immutable evidence bundle tying validation results to exact repository/package snapshots, manifests, hashes, migration coverage and validator metadata.

topics.name: Validation Evidence Bundle
topics.purpose: Define an immutable evidence bundle tying validation results to exact repository/package snapshots, manifests, hashes, migration coverage and validator metadata.

semantics.snapshot_rule: Evidence bundle identifies the exact validated candidate tree.
semantics.hash_rule: Where physical-package integrity matters, evidence references applicable package/member hashes.
semantics.trace_rule: Every acceptance/lock decision can trace to its evidence bundle.
semantics.immutability_rule: Evidence bundle is immutable once issued.
semantics.staleness_rule: Any semantic/source change outside the validated snapshot makes prior evidence stale for the changed scope.
semantics.export_rule: Evidence may be packaged/exported without changing semantic meaning.

invariants.rule: Validation outcomes, findings, exceptions, evidence, baselines and release decisions are explicit machine-readable facts and never silently rewrite source semantics.

hard_gates.condition: evidence bundle cannot identify exact candidate snapshot
changed source continues using stale evidence
bundle claims physical integrity without applicable hash evidence

references.purpose: Evidence bundle includes immutable validation results.
Package integrity may be anchored by hashes.
